summary: Re-tested Apro-Vision ESG dashboard after Dark Navy & Teal Glassmorphism theme overhaul. Verified all 6 routes, search/filter/sort/pagination, dark CARTO map with 15 markers + popup navigation, supplier KPIs/Recharts/anomalies, conformity disclaimer, about workflow, invalid supplier handling, and new theme tokens (DM Sans font, body bg rgb(13,27,46), risk-badge-high color rgb(239,68,68)). Zero functional regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts cleanly centralises new dark-navy/teal palette + glassmorphic component overrides (AppBar, Drawer, Paper, Card all blurred translucent surfaces).
RISK_COLORS exported and consumed via RiskBadge — verified at runtime: HIGH chip computed color = rgb(239,68,68) matches new spec (#ef4444).
RiskMap correctly switched to https://a.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/* tiles and DivIcon .risk-marker dots remain stable.
All data-testid attributes still in place; suspense/lazy routing settles within ~1-2s as previously documented.

Minor: Companies search input testid is `company-search-input` (not `search-input`) and Conformity cards use `data-source-{icon}` (not `data-source-card-*`). The review_request used a slightly different naming — current testids are correct, just noting for future test scripts.
verified_features: Home: dark navy radial-gradient bg (rgb(13,27,46)), title 'Apro-Vision', stat cards, both CTAs
Top nav 5 links present, active link teal-highlighted
Companies: 6 rows, search 'Aurora' filters to 1 row, risk-filter-select opens, row click navigates to /supplier/{id}, Active status chip rendered teal-green soft pill
Solutions: dark CARTO tiles (basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all), 15 .risk-marker dots, map-legend visible, marker popup -> 'View details' navigates to /supplier/s1
Supplier /supplier/s2: pollution-chart-card with 24 recharts-line-dot points (teal line + red anomaly dots visible), 4 anomaly-item entries, supplier-summary-grid renders KPI cards
Conformity: data-source cards present, legal-disclaimer-card with required text, download-whitepaper-btn
Visual: body font-family includes 'DM Sans', heading color rgb(232,237,244) on dark bg (high contrast), no white-on-white observed, glassmorphic cards with subtle borders
